import unreal
components=[]
for c in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.NiagaraComponent):
    a=c.get_asset()
    if a and a.get_path_name()=='/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest.NS_SSPR_ProjTest':
        components.append({'path':c.get_path_name(),'owner':c.get_owner().get_path_name() if c.get_owner() else None,'active':bool(c.is_active()),'tick':bool(c.is_component_tick_enabled()),'solo':bool(c.get_force_solo())})
grids=[]
for g in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.NiagaraDataInterfaceGrid2DCollection):
    p=g.get_path_name()
    if 'NS_SSPR_ProjTest' in p or 'NiagaraComponent' in p:
        binding=g.get_editor_property('render_target_user_parameter')
        parameter=binding.get_editor_property('parameter')
        grids.append({'path':p,'outer':g.get_outer().get_path_name() if g.get_outer() else None,'x':g.get_editor_property('num_cells_x'),'y':g.get_editor_property('num_cells_y'),'attrs':g.get_editor_property('num_attributes'),'clear':bool(g.get_editor_property('clear_before_non_iteration_stage')),'rtParam':str(parameter.get_editor_property('name'))})
print('LIVE_COMPONENTS='+repr(components))
print('LIVE_GRIDS='+repr(grids))
del c
del g
del components
del grids
